title.zh: 卷六十一 表第三: 交聘表中
title.raw: 卷六十一 表第三: 交聘表中 Volume 61 Tables 3: Communication between States 2

cells.content: 世宗大定元年
cells.literal: First year of the Dading era of Emperor Shizong
cells.idiomatic: First year of the Dading reign of Emperor Shizong

cells.content: 十一月，宋人破陝州。 十二月，元帥左監軍高忠建、德昌軍節度使張景仁以罷兵、歸正隆所侵地，報諭宋國。
cells.literal: In the eleventh month, the Song forces captured Shaan Prefecture. In the twelfth month, Marshal Left Overseer Gao Zhongjian and Dechang Army Military Commissioner Zhang Jingren, on the grounds of ceasing hostilities and returning the territory seized in the Zhenglong era, sent a notification to the Song state.
cells.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the Song took Shaan Prefecture. In the twelfth month Marshal Left Overseer Gao Zhongjian and Dechang Army Military Commissioner Zhang Jingren notified the Song court that they would cease fighting and restore the lands seized during the Zhenglong reign.

cells.content: 十一月壬午，尚書右司員外郎完頻兀古出報諭高麗。
cells.literal: On the day renchen of the eleventh month, Supervising Secretary of the Right Bureau Wanyan Wuguchu was sent to notify Goryeo.
cells.idiomatic: On renchen day in the eleventh month, Supervising Secretary of the Right Bureau Wanyan Wuguchu was dispatched to deliver the notification to Goryeo.

cells.content: 二年
cells.literal: Second year
cells.idiomatic: Second year

cells.content: 三月，徒單合喜敗宋吳璘於德順州。 六月，宋翰林學士洪邁、鎮東軍節度使張掄賀上，書詞不依舊式，詔諭洪邁，使歸諭宋主。 七月丁酉，復取原州。 丙午，宋主內禪。 九月，大敗吳璘於德順州。宗尹復取汝州。 十月己丑，詔左副元帥紇石烈志寧伐宋。 十一月癸巳朔，右丞相僕散忠義節制伐宋諸軍。志寧移書張浚，使依皇統舊式通好，浚復書曰：「謹遣使者至麾下議之。」
cells.literal: In the third month, Tushan Hexi defeated the Song general Wu Lin at Dezhou. In the sixth month, Song Hanlin Academician Hong Mai and Zhendong Army Military Commissioner Zhang Lun came to congratulate the emperor; their letter’s wording did not follow the old form, and an edict instructed Hong Mai to return and inform the Song ruler. On the day dingyou of the seventh month, Yuan Prefecture was recovered. On the day bingwu, the Song ruler abdicated in favor of his heir. In the ninth month, Wu Lin was heavily defeated again at Dezhou. Zong Yin recovered Ru Prefecture. On the day jichou of the tenth month, an edict ordered Left Deputy Marshal He Shilie Zhining to attack Song. On the first day of the eleventh month, the day guisi, Right Chancellor Pusan Zhongyi took overall command of the armies attacking Song. Zhining sent a letter to Zhang Jun asking that friendly relations be restored according to the old Huangtong form; Jun replied, “I respectfully send envoys to your headquarters to discuss the matter.”
cells.idiomatic: In the third month Tushan Hexi defeated the Song commander Wu Lin at Dezhou. In the sixth month the Song Hanlin Academician Hong Mai and Zhendong Army Military Commissioner Zhang Lun came to offer congratulations, but their letter did not follow the established format; the court ordered Hong Mai to return and convey this to the Song emperor. On dingyou day in the seventh month Yuan Prefecture was retaken. On bingwu day the Song emperor abdicated in favor of his successor. In the ninth month Wu Lin suffered another major defeat at Dezhou, and Zong Yin recovered Ru Prefecture. On jichou day in the tenth month the Left Deputy Marshal He Shilie Zhining was ordered to campaign against Song. On guisi, the first day of the eleventh month, Right Chancellor Pusan Zhongyi assumed overall command of the armies attacking Song. Zhining wrote to Zhang Jun proposing that friendly relations be restored on the Huangtong model; Jun replied that he would send envoys to Zhining’s headquarters to discuss the matter.

cells.content: 四月，夏左金吾衛上將軍梁元輔、翰林學士焦景顏、押進樞密副都承旨任純忠賀登寶位。再遣武功大夫賀義忠、宣德郎高慎言賀萬春節。 八月癸酉，夏左金吾衛上將軍蘇執禮、匭柙使王琪、押進御史中丞趙良賀尊號。 九月庚子，以尚書左司員外郎完顏正臣為夏生日使。 十二月辛未，以夏乞兵復宋侵地，遣尚書吏部郎中完顏達吉體究陝西利害。夏武功大夫芭里昌祖、宣德郎揚彥敬等賀正旦。
cells.literal: In the fourth month, Western Xia Left Jinwu Guard Senior General Liang Yuanfu, Hanlin Academician Jiao Jingyan, and Escort Commissioner of the Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Ren Chunzhong congratulated the emperor on his accession to the throne. They again sent Military Merit Grand Master He Yizhong and Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Gao Shenyan to congratulate the Wan Spring Festival. On the day you of the eighth month, Western Xia Left Jinwu Guard Senior General Su Zhili, Casket Commissioner Wang Qi, and Escort Commissioner Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhao Liang congratulated the honorific title. On the day gengzi of the ninth month, Supervising Secretary of the Left Bureau Wanyan Zhengchen was appointed envoy for the Xia birthday. On the day xinwei of the twelfth month, because Xia requested troops to recover Song-invaded territory, Supervising Secretary of the Ministry of Personnel Wanyan Daji was sent to investigate the advantages and disadvantages in Shaanxi. Xia Military Merit Grand Master Bali Changzu, Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Yang Yanjing, and others congratulated the New Year.
cells.idiomatic: In the fourth month the Western Xia envoys Left Jinwu Guard Senior General Liang Yuanfu, Hanlin Academician Jiao Jingyan, and Escort Commissioner Ren Chunzhong congratulated the emperor on his accession. A second mission of Military Merit Grand Master He Yizhong and Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Gao Shenyan came for the Wan Spring Festival. On you day in the eighth month Left Jinwu Guard Senior General Su Zhili, Casket Commissioner Wang Qi, and Escort Commissioner Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhao Liang congratulated the new honorific title. On gengzi day in the ninth month Supervising Secretary of the Left Bureau Wanyan Zhengchen was appointed birthday envoy to Xia. On xinwei day in the twelfth month, because Xia asked for troops to recover territory seized by Song, Supervising Secretary of the Ministry of Personnel Wanyan Daji was sent to assess the situation in Shaanxi. Military Merit Grand Master Bali Changzu, Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Yang Yanjing, and others came to congratulate the New Year.

cells.content: 十二月，高麗衛尉少卿丁應起賀正旦。
cells.literal: In the twelfth month, Goryeo Chamberlain for the Palace Liao Minor Official Ding Yingqi congratulated the New Year.
cells.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Goryeo Chamberlain for the Palace Liao Minor Official Ding Yingqi came to congratulate the New Year.

cells.content: 三年
cells.literal: Third year
cells.idiomatic: Third year

cells.content: 五月，宋人破宿州。是月，志寧復取宿州。宋洪遵與志寧書，約為叔姪國。志寧渡淮，取盱眙、濠、廬、和、滁等州。宋使胡昉以湯思退與忠義書，稱姪國，不肯加世字、忠義執胡昉，詔釋之。
cells.literal: In the fifth month, the Song forces captured Suzhou. That same month Zhining recovered Suzhou. Song Hong Zun wrote to Zhining proposing a nephew-state relationship. Zhining crossed the Huai and took Xuyi, Hao, Lu, He, and Chu prefectures, among others. The Song envoy Hu Fang presented a letter from Tang Situo to Zhongyi calling the state a nephew-state but refusing to add the character for “generation”; Zhongyi detained Hu Fang, and an edict ordered his release.
cells.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Song took Suzhou, but that same month Zhining recaptured it. The Song envoy Hong Zun wrote to Zhining proposing that the two states relate as uncle and nephew. Zhining crossed the Huai and seized Xuyi, Hao, Lu, He, Chu, and other prefectures. The Song envoy Hu Fang brought a letter from Tang Situo to Zhongyi styling Song a nephew-state but refusing to include the generational character “great”; Zhongyi detained Hu Fang until an edict ordered him released.

cells.content: 三月壬辰朔，夏武功大夫訛留元智、宣德郎程公濟賀萬春節。 五月，以宿直將軍阿勒根和衍為橫賜夏國使。 七月甲寅，詔市馬於夏國。 九月癸巳，以宿直將軍僕散習尼列為夏生日使。 十月己巳，夏遣金吾衛上將軍蘇執禮、匭匣使李子美謝橫賜。
cells.literal: On the first day of the third month, the day renchen, Xia Military Merit Grand Master Eliao Yuanzhi and Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Cheng Gongji congratulated the Wan Spring Festival. In the fifth month, Palace Duty General Alagen Heyan was appointed sideways-grant envoy to Xia. On the day jiayin of the seventh month, an edict ordered horses purchased in Xia. On the day guisi of the ninth month, Palace Duty General Pusan Xini was appointed Xia birthday envoy. On the day jisi of the tenth month, Xia sent Left Jinwu Guard Senior General Su Zhili and Casket Commissioner Li Zimei to thank them for the sideways grant.
cells.idiomatic: On renchen, the first day of the third month, Xia Military Merit Grand Master Eliao Yuanzhi and Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Cheng Gongji came for the Wan Spring Festival. In the fifth month Palace Duty General Alagen Heyan was appointed sideways-grant envoy to Xia. On jiayin day in the seventh month the court ordered horses purchased in Xia. On guisi day in the ninth month Palace Duty General Pusan Xini was appointed birthday envoy to Xia. On jisi day in the tenth month Left Jinwu Guard Senior General Su Zhili and Casket Commissioner Li Zimei came to thank the court for the sideways grant.

cells.content: 二月庚寅，高麗守司空金永胤、尚書禮部侍郎金淳夫進奉使，禮賔少卿許勢脩賀登寶位，祕書少監金居實謝宣諭。 三月壬辰朔，高麗衛尉少卿李公老賀萬春節。 四月己卯，以引進使韓綱為橫賜高麗使。 十月丙寅，以許王府長史移剌天佛留為高麗生日使。 十二月乙酉，高麗使殿中少監金存夫謝橫賜。
cells.literal: On the day gengyin of the second month, Goryeo Acting Minister of Works Jin Yongyin and Vice Minister of Rites Jin Chunfu came as tribute envoys; Minor Official of Guests Xu Xiuxiu congratulated the accession; Junior Director of the Secretariat Jin Jushi thanked them for the imperial notification. On the first day of the third month, the day renchen, Goryeo Chamberlain for the Palace Liao Minor Official Li Gonglao congratulated the Wan Spring Festival. On the day jimao of the fourth month, Introducing Envoy Han Gang was appointed sideways-grant envoy to Goryeo. On the day bingyin of the tenth month, Chief Administrator of the Xu Prince’s Household Yelü Tianfoliu was appointed Goryeo birthday envoy. On the day you of the twelfth month, Goryeo Palace Attendant Minor Official Jin Cunfu thanked them for the sideways grant.
cells.idiomatic: On gengyin day in the second month Goryeo Acting Minister of Works Jin Yongyin and Vice Minister of Rites Jin Chunfu came as tribute envoys; Minor Official of Guests Xu Xiuxiu congratulated the accession, and Junior Director of the Secretariat Jin Jushi thanked the court for its notification. On renchen, the first day of the third month, Chamberlain for the Palace Liao Minor Official Li Gonglao came for the Wan Spring Festival. On jimao day in the fourth month Introducing Envoy Han Gang was appointed sideways-grant envoy to Goryeo. On bingyin day in the tenth month Chief Administrator of the Xu Prince’s Household Yelü Tianfoliu was appointed birthday envoy to Goryeo. On you day in the twelfth month Palace Attendant Minor Official Jin Cunfu came to thank the court for the sideways grant.

cells.content: 四年
cells.literal: Fourth year
cells.idiomatic: Fourth year

cells.content: 十一月，徒單克寧敗宋兵於十八裡口，克楚州。宋周葵、王之望與忠義書，約世為姪國，書仍書名再拜，不稱「大」字，並以宋書副本來上，和議始定。
cells.literal: In the eleventh month, Tushan Kening defeated Song troops at Shibalikou and captured Chu Prefecture. Song Zhou Kui and Wang Zhiwang wrote to Zhongyi agreeing that the two states would forever be nephew and uncle; the letter still bore their names with a double bow but did not use the character “great,” and they also submitted a copy of the Song letter to the court, whereupon the peace agreement was settled.
cells.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Tushan Kening defeated Song forces at Shibalikou and took Chu Prefecture. Zhou Kui and Wang Zhiwang of Song wrote to Zhongyi agreeing that the two states would forever relate as nephew and uncle; their letter still bore their names with a double bow but omitted the character “great,” and they submitted a copy of the Song letter to the Jin court, after which the peace settlement was finalized.

cells.content: 正月丁亥朔，夏遣武功大夫嵬𠼪執信、宣德郎李師白賀正旦。 三月丙戌朔，夏武功大夫紐臥文忠、宣德郎陳師古賀萬春節。 九月，以宿直將軍宗室烏里雅為夏生日使。 十二月，夏奏告使殿前太尉梁惟忠、翰林學士樞密都承旨焦景顏上章奏告，乞免徵索正隆末年所虜人口。
cells.literal: On the first day of the first month, the day dinghai, Xia sent Military Merit Grand Master Weishou Zhixin and Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Li Shibai to congratulate the New Year. On the first day of the third month, the day bingxu, Xia Military Merit Grand Master Niwo Wenzhong and Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Chen Shigu congratulated the Wan Spring Festival. In the ninth month, Palace Duty General of the Imperial Clan Ulia was appointed Xia birthday envoy. In the twelfth month, Xia memorial envoys Palace Attendant Taiwei Liang Weizhong and Hanlin Academician Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Jiao Jingyan submitted a memorial asking exemption from demands for the population seized in the last years of Zhenglong.
cells.idiomatic: On dinghai, the first day of the first month, Xia sent Military Merit Grand Master Weishou Zhixin and Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Li Shibai for the New Year. On bingxu, the first day of the third month, Military Merit Grand Master Niwo Wenzhong and Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Chen Shigu came for the Wan Spring Festival. In the ninth month Palace Duty General of the Imperial Clan Ulia was appointed birthday envoy to Xia. In the twelfth month Xia memorial envoys Palace Attendant Taiwei Liang Weizhong and Hanlin Academician Jiao Jingyan submitted a memorial requesting that the court cease demanding return of people seized in the final years of the Zhenglong reign.

cells.content: 正月丁亥朔，高麗禮賔少卿高處約賀正旦。 三月丙戌朔，高麗遣秘書少監崔孝溫進奉使，朝散大夫衛尉少卿鄭孝偁賀萬春節。 九月，以太子少詹事烏古論三合為高麗生日使。 十二月，高麗禮賔少卿金莊謝賜生日。
cells.literal: On the first day of the first month, the day dinghai, Goryeo Minor Official of Guests Gao Chuyue congratulated the New Year. On the first day of the third month, the day bingxu, Goryeo sent Junior Director of the Secretariat Cui Xiaowen as tribute envoy and Palace Attendant Minor Official Zheng Xiaocheng to congratulate the Wan Spring Festival. In the ninth month, Junior Tutor to the Heir Ulgurian Sanhe was appointed Goryeo birthday envoy. In the twelfth month, Goryeo Minor Official of Guests Jin Zhuang thanked them for the birthday gift.
cells.idiomatic: On dinghai, the first day of the first month, Goryeo Minor Official of Guests Gao Chuyue came for the New Year. On bingxu, the first day of the third month, Junior Director of the Secretariat Cui Xiaowen came as tribute envoy and Palace Attendant Minor Official Zheng Xiaocheng for the Wan Spring Festival. In the ninth month Junior Tutor to the Heir Ulgurian Sanhe was appointed birthday envoy to Goryeo. In the twelfth month Minor Official of Guests Jin Zhuang came to thank the court for the birthday gift.

cells.content: 五年
cells.literal: Fifth year
cells.idiomatic: Fifth year

cells.content: 正月癸亥，宋通問使禮部尚書魏杞、崇信軍承宣使康湑奉國書及誓書入見。 二月，以殿前左副都點檢完顏仲、太子詹事楊伯雄報問宋國。 三月庚戌，宋禮部尚書洪適、崇信軍承宣使龍大淵賀萬春節。 八月，宋吏部尚書李若川、寧國軍承宣使曾覿等賀尊號。 九月，以吏部尚書高衎、移剌道為宋生日使。 十一月，以殿前右副都點檢烏古論粘沒曷、尚書禮部侍郎劉仲淵為賀宋正旦使。
cells.literal: On the day guihai of the first month, Song envoys for communication, Minister of Rites Wei Qi and Chongxin Army Commissioner Kang Xu, presented the state letter and oath document and were received in audience. In the second month, Left Deputy Commander of the Palace Front Ulgurian Zhong and Tutor to the Heir Yang Boxiong were sent to respond to Song. On the day gengxu of the third month, Song Minister of Rites Hong Shi and Chongxin Army Commissioner Long Dayuan congratulated the Wan Spring Festival. In the eighth month, Song Minister of Personnel Li Ruochuan, Ningguo Army Commissioner Zeng Di, and others congratulated the honorific title. In the ninth month, Minister of Personnel Gao Yan and Yelü Dao were appointed Song birthday envoys. In the eleventh month, Right Deputy Commander of the Palace Front Ulgurian Nianmohua and Vice Minister of Rites Liu Zhongyuan were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.
cells.idiomatic: On guihai day in the first month the Song communication envoys Minister of Rites Wei Qi and Chongxin Army Commissioner Kang Xu presented the state letter and oath document and were received in audience. In the second month Left Deputy Commander of the Palace Front Ulgurian Zhong and Tutor to the Heir Yang Boxiong were sent on a return mission to Song. On gengxu day in the third month Minister of Rites Hong Shi and Chongxin Army Commissioner Long Dayuan came for the Wan Spring Festival. In the eighth month Minister of Personnel Li Ruochuan, Ningguo Army Commissioner Zeng Di, and others congratulated the new honorific title. In the ninth month Minister of Personnel Gao Yan and Yelü Dao were appointed birthday envoys to Song. In the eleventh month Right Deputy Commander of the Palace Front Ulgurian Nianmohua and Vice Minister of Rites Liu Zhongyuan were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.

cells.content: 正月辛亥朔，夏武功大夫訛羅世、宣德郎高嶽賀正旦。 三月庚戌，夏使賀萬春節。 九月，以宿直將軍朮虎蒲查為夏生日使。
cells.literal: On the first day of the first month, the day xinhai, Xia Military Merit Grand Master Eluoshi and Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Gao Yue congratulated the New Year. On the first day of the third month, the day gengxu, Xia envoys congratulated the Wan Spring Festival. In the ninth month, Palace Duty General Tuhu Pucha was appointed Xia birthday envoy.
cells.idiomatic: On xinhai, the first day of the first month, Xia Military Merit Grand Master Eluoshi and Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Gao Yue came for the New Year. On gengxu, the first day of the third month, Xia envoys came for the Wan Spring Festival. In the ninth month Palace Duty General Tuhu Pucha was appointed birthday envoy to Xia.

cells.content: 正月辛亥朔，高麗衛尉少卿高珍縉賀正旦。 三月庚戌，高麗殿中少監陳力升進奉使，祕書少監元頤沖賀萬春節。 十月，以大宗正丞璋為高麗生日使。 十二月，高麗遣吏部尚書李知深、中書舍人尹敦信賀尊號，衛尉少卿王輔謝賜生日。
cells.literal: On the first day of the first month, the day xinhai, Goryeo Palace Attendant Minor Official Gao Zhenjin congratulated the New Year. On the first day of the third month, the day gengxu, Goryeo Palace Attendant Minor Official Chen Lisheng came as tribute envoy and Junior Director of the Secretariat Yuan Yichong congratulated the Wan Spring Festival. In the tenth month, Director of the Imperial Clan Bureau Zhang was appointed Goryeo birthday envoy. In the twelfth month, Goryeo sent Minister of Personnel Li Zhisen and Secretariat Drafter Yin Dunxin to congratulate the honorific title; Palace Attendant Minor Official Wang Fu thanked them for the birthday gift.
cells.idiomatic: On xinhai, the first day of the first month, Goryeo Palace Attendant Minor Official Gao Zhenjin came for the New Year. On gengxu, the first day of the third month, Palace Attendant Minor Official Chen Lisheng came as tribute envoy and Junior Director of the Secretariat Yuan Yichong for the Wan Spring Festival. In the tenth month Director of the Imperial Clan Bureau Zhang was appointed birthday envoy to Goryeo. In the twelfth month Minister of Personnel Li Zhisen and Secretariat Drafter Yin Dunxin congratulated the honorific title, and Palace Attendant Minor Official Wang Fu thanked the court for the birthday gift.

cells.content: 六年
cells.literal: Sixth year
cells.idiomatic: Sixth year

cells.content: 正月丙午朔，宋戶部尚書方滋、福州觀察使王抃賀正旦。 三月甲辰朔，宋吏部尚書王曮、利州觀察使魏仲昌賀萬春節。 九月，以戶部尚書魏子平、殿前左衛將軍夾谷查剌為賀宋生日使。 十一月，以殿前右副都點檢駙馬都尉烏古論元忠、少府監張仲愈為賀宋正旦使。
cells.literal: On the first day of the first month, the day bingwu, Song Minister of Revenue Fang Zi and Fuzhou Observation Commissioner Wang Bian congratulated the New Year. On the first day of the third month, the day jiachen, Song Minister of Personnel Wang Yan and Lizhou Observation Commissioner Wei Zhongchang congratulated the Wan Spring Festival. In the ninth month, Minister of Revenue Wei Ziping and Left Guard General of the Palace Front Jiagu Chala were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday. In the eleventh month, Right Deputy Commander of the Palace Front and Commissioner-in-Chief of the Empress’s Household Ulgurian Yuanzhong and Director of the Palace Workshops Zhang Zhongyu were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.
cells.idiomatic: On bingwu, the first day of the first month, Song Minister of Revenue Fang Zi and Fuzhou Observation Commissioner Wang Bian came for the New Year. On jiachen, the first day of the third month, Minister of Personnel Wang Yan and Lizhou Observation Commissioner Wei Zhongchang came for the Wan Spring Festival. In the ninth month Minister of Revenue Wei Ziping and Left Guard General of the Palace Front Jiagu Chala were appointed envoys to congratulate the Song emperor on his birthday. In the eleventh month Right Deputy Commander of the Palace Front Ulgurian Yuanzhong and Director of the Palace Workshops Zhang Zhongyu were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.

cells.content: 正月丙午朔，夏武功大夫高遵義、宣德郎安世等賀正旦。 三月甲辰朔，夏武功大夫曹公達、宣德郎孟伯達、押進知中興府趙衍賀萬春節。 戊申，夏御史中丞李克勤、翰林學士焦景顏奏告，乞免索正隆末年所虜人口，許之。 四月戊戌，以宿直將軍斜卯摑剌為橫賜使。 九月辛亥，以翰林待制移剌熈載為夏生日使。 十二月戊戌，夏御史中丞賀義忠、翰林學士楊彥敬謝橫賜。
cells.literal: On the first day of the first month, the day bingwu, Xia Military Merit Grand Master Gao Zunyi and Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman An Shi and others congratulated the New Year. On the first day of the third month, the day jiachen, Xia Military Merit Grand Master Cao Gongda, Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Meng Boda, and Escort Commissioner and Acting Prefect of Zhongxing Fu Zhao Yan congratulated the Wan Spring Festival. On the day wushen, Xia Vice Censor-in-Chief Li Keqin and Hanlin Academician Jiao Jingyan submitted a memorial asking exemption from demands for the population seized in the last years of Zhenglong; this was granted. On the day wuxu of the fourth month, Palace Duty General Xiemao Guala was appointed sideways-grant envoy. On the day xinhai of the ninth month, Hanlin Attendant Drafting Yelü Xizai was appointed Xia birthday envoy. On the day wuxu of the twelfth month, Xia Vice Censor-in-Chief He Yizhong and Hanlin Academician Yang Yanjing thanked them for the sideways grant.
cells.idiomatic: On bingwu, the first day of the first month, Xia Military Merit Grand Master Gao Zunyi and Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman An Shi and others came for the New Year. On jiachen, the first day of the third month, Military Merit Grand Master Cao Gongda, Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Meng Boda, and Escort Commissioner Zhao Yan, acting prefect of Zhongxing, came for the Wan Spring Festival. On wushen day Vice Censor-in-Chief Li Keqin and Hanlin Academician Jiao Jingyan memorialized asking that the court cease demanding return of people seized in the Zhenglong years; the request was granted. On wuxu day in the fourth month Palace Duty General Xiemao Guala was appointed sideways-grant envoy. On wuxu day in the twelfth month Vice Censor-in-Chief He Yizhong and Hanlin Academician Yang Yanjing came to thank the court for the sideways grant.

cells.content: 正月丙午朔，高麗太府少卿李世儀賀正旦。 三月甲辰朔，高麗國子司業趙仁貴進奉使，秘書少監李復基等賀萬春節。 四月戊戌，以尚書右司郎中移剌道為橫賜高麗使。 十月己卯，以尚書兵部侍郎移剌按荅為高麗生日使。 十二月戊戌，高麗禮賔少卿崔椿謝賜生日，衛尉少卿金資用謝橫賜。

cells.literal: Seventh year
cells.idiomatic: Seventh year

cells.idiomatic: Eighth year

cells.content: 正月戊午朔，宋試工部尚書鄭聞、明州觀察使董誡等賀正旦。 三月丁巳朔，宋翰林學士胡元質、保康軍承宣使宋直溫等賀萬春節。 九月，以刑部尚書高德基為賀宋生日使。 十一月，以京兆尹宗室毅、尚書左司郎中牛德昌為賀宋正旦使。

cells.content: 正月戊午朔，夏武功大夫莊浪義顯、宣德郎劉裕等賀正旦。 三月丁巳朔，夏武功大夫渾進忠、宣德郎王德昌等賀萬春節。 五月丙辰，以宿直將軍完顏賽也為橫賜夏國使。 九月，以宿直將軍僕散守忠為夏生日使。

cells.content: 十年
cells.literal: Tenth year
cells.idiomatic: Tenth year

cells.content: 正月壬子朔，宋試吏部尚書汪大猷、寧國軍承宣使曾覿賀正旦。 三月壬子朔，宋試工部尚書司馬伋、泉州觀察使馬定遠等賀萬春節。閏五月丁酉，尚書省奏宋祈請使赴闕日期，詔以九月十一日朝見。 九月，以簽書樞密院事移剌子敬、宮籍監張僅言為賀宋生日使。 丙戌，宋祈請使資政殿大學士范成大、崇信軍節度使康湑至，求免起立接受國書，詔不許。 十一月，以太子詹事蒲察蒲速越、同知宣徽院事韓綱為賀宋正旦使。
cells.literal: On the first day of the first month, the day renzi, Acting Minister of Personnel of Song Wang Dayou and Ningguo Army Commissioner Zeng Di congratulated the New Year. On the first day of the third month, the day renzi, Acting Minister of Works Sima Ji, Quanzhou Observation Commissioner Ma Dingyuan, and others congratulated the Wan Spring Festival. On the day dingyou of the intercalary fifth month, the Secretariat memorialized the date on which the Song petition envoys would arrive at court; an edict set the audience for the eleventh day of the ninth month. In the ninth month, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Yelü Zijing and Palace Registry Commissioner Zhang Jinyan were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday. On the day bingxu, Song petition envoys Grand Councillor of the Hall for Aid to Governance Fan Chengda and Chongxin Army Military Commissioner Kang Xu arrived and asked to be excused from rising to receive the state letter; an edict refused. In the eleventh month, Tutor to the Heir Pucha Pusuyue and Vice Commissioner of the Palace Directorate Han Gang were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.

In the eleventh month Tutor to the Heir Pucha Pusuyue and Vice Commissioner of the Palace Directorate Han Gang were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.

cells.content: 正月壬子朔，夏武功大夫劉志直、宣德郎韓德容等賀正旦。 三月壬子朔，夏武功大夫張兼善、宣德郎李師白等賀萬春節。 丁丑，詔以夏奏告使於閏五月十六就行在。閏五月乙未，夏權臣任得敬中分其國，脅其主李仁孝遣左樞密使浪訛進忠、參知政事楊彥敬、押進翰林學士焦景顏等上表為得敬求封，詔不許，遣使詳問。 七月庚子，宋人以蠟丸書遺任得敬，夏執其人並書以來。 九月庚寅，以尚書戶部郎中夾古阿里補為夏生日使。 十一月癸巳，夏以誅任得敬，遣其殿前太尉芭里昌祖、樞密直學士高岳等上表陳謝。
cells.literal: On the first day of the first month, the day renzi, Xia Military Merit Grand Master Liu Zhizhi and Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Han Derong and others congratulated the New Year. On the first day of the third month, the day renzi, Xia Military Merit Grand Master Zhang Jianshan, Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Li Shibai, and others congratulated the Wan Spring Festival. On the day dingchou, an edict ordered that the Xia memorial envoy depart for the traveling palace on the sixteenth day of the intercalary fifth month. On the day yiwei of the intercalary fifth month, Xia power-holder Ren Dedun divided the state in half and coerced his ruler Li Renxiao to send Left Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Lang Ejinzhong, Vice Administrator Yang Yanjing, Escort Commissioner Hanlin Academician Jiao Jingyan, and others to submit a memorial requesting enfeoffment for Dedun; an edict refused and envoys were sent for a detailed inquiry. On the day gengzi of the seventh month, the Song sent a wax-sealed letter to Ren Dedun; Xia seized the man and the letter and brought them to the court. On the day gengyin of the ninth month, Supervising Secretary of the Ministry of Revenue Jiagu Alibu was appointed Xia birthday envoy. On the day guisi of the eleventh month, because Ren Dedun had been executed, Xia sent Palace Attendant Taiwei Bali Changzu, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Gao Yue, and others to submit a memorial of apology.
cells.idiomatic: On renzi, the first day of the first month, Xia Military Merit Grand Master Liu Zhizhi and Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Han Derong and others came for the New Year. On yiwei day in the intercalary fifth month the Xia power-holder Ren Dedun partitioned the realm and forced his ruler Li Renxiao to send Left Commissioner Lang Ejinzhong, Vice Administrator Yang Yanjing, Escort Commissioner Hanlin Academician Jiao Jingyan, and others to request enfeoffment for Dedun; the court refused and sent envoys to investigate. On gengzi day in the seventh month Song sent a wax-sealed letter to Ren Dedun; Xia seized the courier and the letter and presented both to the Jin court. On gengyin day in the ninth month Supervising Secretary of the Ministry of Revenue Jiagu Alibu was appointed birthday envoy to Xia. On guisi day in the eleventh month, after Ren Dedun had been executed, Xia sent Palace Attendant Taiwei Bali Changzu, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Gao Yue, and others to submit a memorial of apology.

cells.content: 正月壬子朔，高麗禮賔少卿陳升賀正旦。 三月壬子朔，高麗衛尉少卿崔侁進奉使，尚書禮部侍郎崔光涉等賀萬春節。 十月己酉，以大宗正丞宗室乣為高麗生日使。 十一月己卯，高麗翼陽公皓廢晛自立，不肯接受賜王晛生日使，王皓稱兄晛讓國，求封冊。詔遣使詳問。
cells.literal: On the first day of the first month, the day renzi, Goryeo Minor Official of Guests Chen Sheng congratulated the New Year. On the first day of the third month, the day renzi, Goryeo Palace Attendant Minor Official Cui Yi came as tribute envoy, and Vice Minister of Rites Cui Guangshe and others congratulated the Wan Spring Festival. On the day jiyou of the tenth month, Director of the Imperial Clan Bureau Jiu of the Imperial Clan was appointed Goryeo birthday envoy. On the day jimao of the eleventh month, Goryeo Prince of Yiyang Hao deposed Xian and installed himself, refusing to receive the envoy congratulating King Xian on his birthday; Hao claimed that his elder brother Xian had yielded the throne and requested investiture; an edict ordered envoys sent to investigate in detail.

cells.content: 十一年
cells.literal: Eleventh year
cells.idiomatic: Eleventh year

cells.content: 正月丙子朔，宋試工部尚書呂正己、利州觀察使辛堅之賀正旦。 三月乙亥，宋翰林學士趙雄、泉州觀察使趙伯驌等賀萬春節。 八月，以尚書刑部侍郎駙馬都尉烏林荅天錫、御史中丞李文蔚為賀宋生日使。 十一月，以西南路招討使宗室宗寧、戶部侍郎程輝為賀宋正旦使。

cells.content: 正月壬辰，高麗王皓報稱，前王久病，昏耗不治，以母弟皓權攝國事。 四月丁卯，權軍國事王皓上表，並以兄晛表求封。 五月，以尚書吏部侍郎宗室靖為宣問高麗王晛使。靖至高麗，皓稱晛避位出居他所，病加無損，不能就位拜命，往復險遠，非使者所宜往，乃以王晛表附奏。其表大概與前表同。 十二月丁卯，權高麗國事王皓告奏使、尚書禮部侍郎張翼明以王皓表求封。
cells.literal: On the day renchen of the first month, Goryeo King Hao reported that the former king had long been ill, confused and unable to govern, and that he, Hao, the younger brother of the queen mother, was temporarily administering state affairs. On the day dingmao of the fourth month, Hao, acting as regent of military and state affairs, submitted a memorial, together with a memorial from his elder brother Xian requesting investiture. In the fifth month, Vice Minister of Personnel Jing of the Imperial Clan was appointed envoy to inquire of Goryeo King Xian. When Jing reached Goryeo, Hao said Xian had yielded the throne and was living elsewhere, that his illness was worsening and he could not come to receive the command in person, that the journey back and forth was perilous and unsuitable for an envoy, and he therefore attached Xian’s memorial to his submission. The memorial’s gist was much the same as the earlier one. On the day dingmao of the twelfth month, Hao, acting regent of Goryeo, sent memorial envoy Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Yiming with Hao’s memorial requesting investiture.
cells.idiomatic: On renchen day in the first month King Hao of Goryeo reported that the former king had long been ill and unable to govern, and that he, the queen mother’s younger brother, was temporarily administering affairs. On dingmao day in the fourth month Regent Hao submitted a memorial, along with his elder brother Xian’s memorial requesting investiture. In the fifth month Vice Minister of Personnel Jing of the Imperial Clan was appointed envoy to inquire of King Xian. When Jing reached Goryeo, Hao said Xian had abdicated and was living elsewhere, that his illness was worsening and he could not come to receive the command, that the route was too dangerous for an envoy, and he attached Xian’s memorial. Its gist matched the earlier petition. On dingmao day in the twelfth month Regent Hao sent memorial envoy Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Yiming with another memorial requesting investiture.

cells.content: 正月己丑朔，宋翰林學士留正、利州觀察使張薿等賀正旦。 癸巳，宋使朝辭，尚書省奏，宋來書語涉平易，遣人就館諭宋使。大興尹璋至宋，宋人就館奪其國書，璋乃赴其宴、受其私物，璋坐除名。 二月，以刑部尚書梁肅、趙王府長史蒲察訛里剌為詳問宋國使。 三月戊子朔，宋遣戶部尚書韓彥直、保信軍承宣使劉炎等賀萬春節。梁肅等至宋，宋主接書如舊儀。 五月，梁肅等還，宋主以謝書附奏。 九月，以兵部尚書完顏讓、秘書少監賈少沖為賀宋生日使。 己酉，宋試工部尚書張子顏、明州觀察使劉崈為報聘使，仍求免起立接書，詔不許。 十一月，以御史中丞劉仲誨、殿前左衛將軍兼修起居注紇石烈奧也等為賀宋正旦使。
cells.literal: On the first day of the first month, the day jichou, Song Hanlin Academician Liu Zheng and Lizhou Observation Commissioner Zhang Wei and others congratulated the New Year. On the day guisi, the Song envoys took leave of court; the Secretariat memorialized that the wording of the Song letter was overly plain, and persons were sent to the lodging to instruct the Song envoys. Metropolitan Governor Zhang of Daxing reached Song, and Song men went to the lodging and seized the state letter; Zhang then attended their banquet and accepted their private gifts, for which he was dismissed from office. In the second month, Minister of Punishments Liang Su and Chief Administrator of the Zhao Prince’s Household Pucha Elila were appointed envoys to conduct a detailed inquiry in Song. On the first day of the third month, the day wuzi, Song sent Minister of Revenue Han Yanzhi, Baoxin Army Commissioner Liu Yan, and others to congratulate the Wan Spring Festival. When Liang Su and the others reached Song, the Song ruler received the letter according to the old rites. In the fifth month, Liang Su and the others returned, and the Song ruler attached a letter of thanks to their memorial. In the ninth month, Minister of War Wanyan Rang and Junior Director of the Secretariat Jia Shaochong were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday. On the day jiyou, Acting Minister of Works of Song Zhang Ziyan and Mingzhou Observation Commissioner Liu Kun came as return envoys and again asked to be excused from rising to receive the letter; an edict refused. In the eleventh month, Vice Censor-in-Chief Liu Zhonghui, Left Guard General of the Palace Front and Compiler of the Imperial Diary He Shilie Aoye, and others were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.
cells.idiomatic: On jichou, the first day of the first month, Hanlin Academician Liu Zheng and Lizhou Observation Commissioner Zhang Wei and others of Song came for the New Year. On guisi day the Song envoys took leave; the Secretariat reported that the Song letter’s wording was too informal and staff were sent to the lodging to admonish the envoys. When Metropolitan Governor Zhang reached Song, Song officials seized the state letter at the lodging; Zhang still attended their banquet and accepted private gifts and was stripped of office. In the second month Minister of Punishments Liang Su and Chief Administrator of the Zhao Prince’s Household Pucha Elila were appointed envoys to conduct a detailed inquiry in Song. On wuzi, the first day of the third month, Minister of Revenue Han Yanzhi, Baoxin Army Commissioner Liu Yan, and others came for the Wan Spring Festival. In Song the emperor received Liang Su’s letter according to the old rites. In the fifth month Liang Su returned with a letter of thanks from the Song emperor. In the ninth month Minister of War Wanyan Rang and Junior Director of the Secretariat Jia Shaochong were appointed birthday envoys to Song. On jiyou day Acting Minister of Works Zhang Ziyan and Mingzhou Observation Commissioner Liu Kun came on a return mission and again asked to be excused from standing to receive the letter; the court refused. In the eleventh month Vice Censor-in-Chief Liu Zhonghui and Left Guard General He Shilie Aoye, also compiler of the imperial diary, were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.

cells.content: 七月丙申，曷懶路奏，得高麗邊報，以其西京留守趙位寵作亂，欲遣告奏，而義州路梗不通，欲由定州入曷懶路，詔許之。 九月，高麗西京留守趙位寵遣徐彥等進表，欲以慈悲嶺以西、鴨綠江以東內附，詔不許。閏九月辛酉，高麗國王王皓以平趙位寵之亂，遣祕書少監樸紹奉表告奏。 十一月戊辰，以宿直將軍阿典蒲魯虎為高麗生日使。 十二月丙午，高麗遣朝散大夫禮賔少卿趙永仁謝賜生日。
cells.literal: On the day bingshen of the seventh month, Yilan Circuit reported receiving a Goryeo frontier bulletin that Western Capital Military Commissioner Zhao Weichong had rebelled and wished to send a memorial of report, but the route through Uiju was blocked; they asked to enter by Ding Prefecture through Yilan Circuit, and an edict permitted this. In the ninth month, Goryeo Western Capital Military Commissioner Zhao Weichong sent Xu Yan and others with a memorial offering to submit the region west of Cibei Ridge and east of the Yalu River; an edict refused. On the day xinyou of the intercalary ninth month, King Hao of Goryeo, having suppressed Zhao Weichong’s rebellion, sent Junior Director of the Secretariat Park So with a memorial of report. On the day wuchen of the eleventh month, Palace Duty General Adian Puluhu was appointed Goryeo birthday envoy. On the day bingwu of the twelfth month, Goryeo sent Palace Attendant Gentleman Minor Official of Guests Zhao Yongren to thank them for the birthday gift.

cells.content: 十六年
cells.literal: Sixteenth year
cells.idiomatic: Sixteenth year

cells.content: 正月戊申朔，宋試戶部尚書謝廓然、泉州觀察使黃夷行等賀正旦。 三月丙午朔，宋試工部尚書張宗元、利州觀察使謝純孝等賀萬春節。 壬子，宋翰林學士知誥朝散大夫湯邦彥、昭信軍承宣使陳雷等奉書申請。 丙辰，宋申請使朝辭，上以書荅之。 九月，以殿前都點檢蒲察通、尚書左司郎中張亨為賀宋生日使。 十一月，以同知宣徽院事劉珫、近侍局使烏林荅願為賀宋正旦使。

cells.content: 正月甲寅朔，宋試禮部尚書陳峴、宜州觀察使孔異賀正旦。 三月癸丑朔，宋試工部尚書傅淇、婺州觀察使王公弼等賀萬春節。 九月，以太府監李佾、尚書左司郎中完顏烏裡也為賀宋生日使。 十一月，以真定尹駙馬都尉徒單守素、左諫議大夫楊伯仁為賀宋正旦使。
cells.literal: On the first day of the first month, the day jiayin, Acting Minister of Rites of Song Chen Xian and Yizhou Observation Commissioner Kong Yi congratulated the New Year. On the first day of the third month, the day guichou, Acting Minister of Works of Song Fu Qi, Wuzhou Observation Commissioner Wang Gongbi, and others congratulated the Wan Spring Festival. In the ninth month, Director of the Imperial Storehouse Li Yi and Supervising Secretary of the Left Bureau Wanyan Wuliye were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday. In the eleventh month, Metropolitan Governor of Zhending and Commissioner-in-Chief of the Empress’s Household Tushan Shousu and Left Remonstrator Yang Boren were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.

cells.content: 正月甲寅朔，夏武功大夫安德信、宣德郎吳日休賀正旦。 三月癸丑朔，夏武功大夫罔進忠、宣德郎王禹玉賀萬春節。 九月壬戌，以少府少監宗室賽補為夏生日使。 十二月癸卯，詔有司，夏使入界，如遇當月小盡，限二十五日至都，二十七朝見。 丙午，夏遣奏告使御史中丞罔永德、樞密直學士劉昭等入見。
cells.literal: On the first day of the first month, the day jiayin, Xia Military Merit Grand Master An Dexin and Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Wu Rixiu congratulated the New Year. On the first day of the third month, the day guichou, Xia Military Merit Grand Master Wang Jinzhong and Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Wang Yuyu congratulated the Wan Spring Festival. On the day renxu of the ninth month, Assistant Director of the Imperial Workshops Sai Bu of the Imperial Clan was appointed Xia birthday envoy. On the day guimao of the twelfth month, an edict ordered the relevant offices that when Xia envoys entered the border, if the month was a short month they were to reach the capital within twenty-five days and have audience on the twenty-seventh. On the day bingwu, Xia sent memorial envoy Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Yongde, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Liu Zhao, and others to audience.

On bingwu day memorial envoys Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Yongde and Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Liu Zhao and others were received in audience.

cells.content: 正月甲寅朔，高麗尚書戶部侍郎尹東輔賀正旦。 二月辛亥，高麗尚書吏部侍郎金鉉公進奉。 三月癸丑朔，高麗尚書戶部侍郎孫碩賀萬春節。 四月己亥，以西上閤門使郭喜國為橫賜高麗使。 十一月乙亥，以太常少卿任倜為高麗生日使。 十二月丙午，高麗禮賔少卿沈晉升謝生日，禮賔少卿王度等謝橫賜。
cells.literal: On the first day of the first month, the day jiayin, Goryeo Vice Minister of Revenue Yin Dongfu congratulated the New Year. On the day xinhai of the second month, Goryeo Vice Minister of Personnel Jin Xuangong came as tribute envoy. On the first day of the third month, the day guichou, Goryeo Vice Minister of Revenue Sun Shuo congratulated the Wan Spring Festival. On the day jihai of the fourth month, Western Upper Gate Commissioner Guo Xiguo was appointed sideways-grant envoy to Goryeo. On the day yihai of the eleventh month, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Ren Ti was appointed Goryeo birthday envoy. On the day bingwu of the twelfth month, Goryeo Minor Official of Guests Shen Jinsheng thanked them for the birthday gift, and Minor Official of Guests Wang Du and others thanked them for the sideways grant.

cells.content: 二十一年
cells.literal: Twenty-first year
cells.idiomatic: Twenty-first year

cells.content: 正月戊申朔，宋龍圖閣學士葉宏、福州觀察使張詔賀正旦。 三月丁未朔，宋試戶部尚書蓋經、閬州觀察使裴良能等賀萬春節。 八月，以殿前右副都點檢宗室胡什賚、尚書左司郎中鄧儼為賀宋生日使。
cells.literal: On the first day of the first month, the day wushen, Song Dragon Hall Academician Ye Hong and Fuzhou Observation Commissioner Zhang Shao congratulated the New Year. On the first day of the third month, the day dingwei, Acting Minister of Revenue of Song Gai Jing, Langzhou Observation Commissioner Pei Liangneng, and others congratulated the Wan Spring Festival. In the eighth month, Right Deputy Commander of the Palace Front Hushen of the Imperial Clan and Supervising Secretary of the Left Bureau Deng Yan were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday.

cells.content: 正月戊申朔，夏遣武功大夫謀寧好德、宣德郎郝處俊賀正旦。 三月丁未朔，夏武功大夫蘇志純、宣德郎康忠義等賀萬春節。 四月戊辰，以滕王府長史把德固為橫賜夏使。 八月乙丑，以尚書吏部郎中奚胡失海為夏生日使。

cells.content: 正月戊申朔，高麗尚書禮部侍郎賀正旦。 二月甲辰，高麗尚書吏部侍郎李德基進奉。 三月丁未朔，高麗尚書戶部侍郎申寶至賀萬春節。

cells.literal: Twenty-second year
cells.idiomatic: Twenty-second year

cells.content: 三月辛未朔，宋使賀萬春節。 九月，以殿前左衛將軍宗室禪赤、翰林直學士呂忠翰為賀宋生日使。 十一月，以昭毅大將軍吏部尚書孛朮魯阿魯罕、中大夫都水監宋中為賀宋正旦使。

In the eleventh month, General of Illustrious Martiality Minister of Personnel Boluolu Aruhan and Grand Master Director of the Directorate of Waterways Song Zhong were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.

cells.literal: Twenty-third year
cells.idiomatic: Twenty-third year

cells.content: 正月丁卯朔，宋試吏部尚書王藺、明州觀察使劉㢸賀正旦。 三月丙寅朔，宋試工部尚書賈選、武奉軍承宣使鄭興裔等賀萬春節。 九月，以同簽大宗正事宗室方、同知宣徽院事劉瑋為賀宋生日使。閏十一月，以西京留守宗室婆盧火、尚食局使李潓為賀宋正旦使。

cells.content: 正月丁卯朔，夏武功大夫劉進忠、宣德郎李國安等賀正旦。 三月丙寅朔，夏武功大夫吳德昌、宣德郎劉思忠等賀萬春節。 九月己巳，以宿直將軍完顏斜里虎為夏生日使。

cells.content: 正月丁卯朔，高麗尚書禮部侍郎崔永濡賀正旦。 二月甲子，高麗戶部侍郎文章煒進奉。 三月丙寅朔，高麗戶部侍郎盧孝敦賀萬春節。 四月癸丑，以大理正紇石烈述列速為橫賜高麗使。 十二月丁亥，高麗使崔孝著朝辭，以詔荅王皓。是歲，皓母任氏薨。

cells.content: 二十四年
cells.literal: Twenty-fourth year
cells.idiomatic: Twenty-fourth year

cells.content: 正月辛卯朔，宋顯謨閣學士余端禮、宜州觀察使王德顯等賀正旦。 三月庚寅朔，宋試吏部尚書陳居仁、隨州觀察使賀錫來賀萬春節。 八月，以太府監張大節、尚書左司郎中完顏婆盧火為賀宋生日使。 十一月甲午，詔上京地遠天寒，行人跋涉艱苦，來歲宋國正旦、生日並不須遣使。
cells.literal: On the first day of the first month, the day xinmao, Song Academician of the Xianmo Pavilion Yu Duanli and Yizhou Observation Commissioner Wang Dexian and others congratulated the New Year. On the first day of the third month, the day gengyin, Acting Minister of Personnel of Song Chen Juren and Suizhou Observation Commissioner He Xilai congratulated the Wan Spring Festival. In the eighth month, Director of the Imperial Storehouse Zhang Dajie and Supervising Secretary of the Left Bureau Wanyan Poluhuo were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday. On the day jiawu of the eleventh month, an edict stated that the upper capital was remote and the weather severe, and that travelers suffered hardship on the road; for the coming year envoys were not to be sent for Song’s New Year and birthday.
cells.idiomatic: On xinmao, the first day of the first month, Academician of the Xianmo Pavilion Yu Duanli and Yizhou Observation Commissioner Wang Dexian and others of Song came for the New Year. On gengyin, the first day of the third month, Acting Minister of Personnel Chen Juren and Suizhou Observation Commissioner He Xilai came for the Wan Spring Festival. In the eighth month Director of the Imperial Storehouse Zhang Dajie and Supervising Secretary of the Left Bureau Wanyan Poluhuo were appointed envoys to congratulate the Song emperor on his birthday. On jiawu day in the eleventh month an edict noted that the upper capital was remote and bitterly cold and that travelers suffered on the road; for the coming year no envoys were to be sent for Song’s New Year and birthday.

cells.content: 正月辛卯朔，夏武功大夫劉執中、宣德郎李昌輔賀正旦。 二月丙戌，以器物局使宗室㐭為橫賜夏國使。 三月庚寅朔，夏武功大夫晁直信、宣德郎王庭彥等賀萬春節。 五月丙申，尚書省奏，夏國王以車駕幸上京，願遣使入賀。上曰：「往復萬里，暑雨泥濘不須遣使。」令諭止之。 八月癸亥，以侍御史遙里特末哥為夏生日使。 十月丙辰朔，詔上京地遠天寒，行人跋涉艱苦，來歲賀正旦、生日、謝橫賜使，權止一年。
cells.literal: On the first day of the first month, the day xinmao, Xia Military Merit Grand Master Liu Zhizhong and Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Li Changfu congratulated the New Year. On the day bingxu of the second month, Director of the Implements Office Lin of the Imperial Clan was appointed sideways-grant envoy to Xia. On the first day of the third month, the day gengyin, Xia Military Merit Grand Master Chao Zhixin and Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Wang Tingyan and others congratulated the Wan Spring Festival. On the day bingshen of the fifth month, the Secretariat memorialized that the Xia king, because the emperor was visiting the upper capital, wished to send envoys to congratulate him; the emperor said, “The journey back and forth is ten thousand li; in summer rains and mud there is no need to send envoys,” and ordered them told to desist. On the day guihai of the eighth month, Attendant Censor Yaoli Temoge was appointed Xia birthday envoy. On the first day of the tenth month, the day bingchen, an edict stated that the upper capital was remote and the weather severe, and that travelers suffered hardship on the road; for the coming year envoys congratulating the New Year, birthday, and thanking for the sideways grant were temporarily suspended for one year.
cells.idiomatic: On xinmao, the first day of the first month, Xia Military Merit Grand Master Liu Zhizhong and Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Li Changfu came for the New Year. On bingxu day in the second month Director of the Implements Office Lin of the Imperial Clan was appointed sideways-grant envoy to Xia. On gengyin, the first day of the third month, Military Merit Grand Master Chao Zhixin and Virtue-Proclaiming Gentleman Wang Tingyan and others came for the Wan Spring Festival. On bingshen day in the fifth month the Secretariat reported that the Xia king wished to send envoys to congratulate the emperor at the upper capital; the emperor said the round trip was ten thousand li and that in summer heat and mud there was no need for envoys, and ordered them told to stop. On guihai day in the eighth month Attendant Censor Yaoli Temoge was appointed birthday envoy to Xia. On bingchen, the first day of the tenth month, an edict suspended for one year envoys for the New Year, birthday, and thanks for the sideways grant, citing the hardship of travel to the remote upper capital.

cells.content: 二月甲戌，高麗王王皓以母憂未卒哭，請免今年萬春節及進貢。詔以王皓未經起復，不當陳賀，其進貢方物宜令隨明年賀正旦使同來。 丙戌，以高麗王皓母喪，遣東上閤門使完顏進兒、翰林修撰郝俁為勑祭使，西上閤門使大仲尹為慰問使，虞王府長史永明為起復使。 十月丙辰朔，詔上京地遠天寒，行人跋涉艱苦，來歲高麗賀正旦、生辰、進奉使，權止一年。其謝勑祭、慰問、起復三番人使，令以後隨朝賀人使同來。
cells.literal: On the day jiaxu of the second month, King Hao of Goryeo, because his mother was in mourning and he had not yet completed the initial mourning rites, asked to be excused from this year’s Wan Spring Festival and tribute presentation. An edict stated that since Hao had not yet resumed office he should not offer congratulations; the tribute goods might come with next year’s New Year envoy. On the day bingxu, because of the mourning for Hao’s mother, Eastern Upper Gate Commissioner Wanyan Jiner and Hanlin Compiler Hao Yi were sent as imperial condolence envoys, Western Upper Gate Commissioner Da Zhongyin as consolation envoy, and Chief Administrator of the Yu Prince’s Household Yongming as envoy to urge resumption of office. On the first day of the tenth month, the day bingchen, an edict stated that the upper capital was remote and the weather severe, and that travelers suffered hardship on the road; for the coming year Goryeo envoys for the New Year, birthday, and tribute were temporarily suspended for one year. The three missions thanking for imperial condolence, consolation, and urging resumption were to come later with the regular congratulatory envoys.
cells.idiomatic: On jiaxu day in the second month King Hao of Goryeo, his mother still in mourning and the initial rites not yet complete, asked to be excused from the Wan Spring Festival and tribute for that year. The court ruled that since Hao had not resumed office he should not offer congratulations, but that tribute goods might arrive with next year’s New Year envoy. On bingxu day, because of the queen mother’s death, Eastern Upper Gate Commissioner Wanyan Jiner and Hanlin Compiler Hao Yi were sent as imperial condolence envoys, Western Upper Gate Commissioner Da Zhongyin as consolation envoy, and Chief Administrator of the Yu Prince’s Household Yongming to urge Hao’s return to office. On bingchen, the first day of the tenth month, an edict suspended for one year Goryeo envoys for the New Year, birthday, and tribute, citing travel hardship to the upper capital; the three missions of thanks for condolence, consolation, and urging resumption were to follow with the regular congratulatory envoys.

cells.content: 二十五年
cells.literal: Twenty-fifth year
cells.idiomatic: Twenty-fifth year

cells.content: 十一月，以臨潢尹僕散守中、御史中丞馬惠迪為賀宋正旦使。 十二月，宋遣試禮部尚書王信、明州觀察使吳瓌賀正旦。
cells.literal: In the eleventh month, Metropolitan Governor of Linhuang Pusan Shouzhong and Vice Censor-in-Chief Ma Huidi were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year. In the twelfth month, Song sent Acting Minister of Rites Wang Xin and Mingzhou Observation Commissioner Wu Gui to congratulate the New Year.

cells.content: 十一月丙申，夏國以車駕還京，賀尊安使御史大夫李崇懿、中興尹米崇吉、押進匭匣使李嗣卿等朝見。
cells.literal: On the day bingshen of the eleventh month, because the emperor’s carriage had returned to the capital, Xia envoys congratulating the Secure Tranquility honorific title—Censor-in-Chief Li Chongyi, Acting Prefect of Zhongxing Mi Chongji, Escort Commissioner Casket Commissioner Li Siqing, and others—were received in audience.
cells.idiomatic: On bingshen day in the eleventh month, because the imperial procession had returned to the capital, Xia envoys who had come to congratulate the Secure Tranquility honorific title—Censor-in-Chief Li Chongyi, Acting Prefect of Zhongxing Mi Chongji, Escort Commissioner Casket Commissioner Li Siqing, and others—were received in audience.

cells.content: 十一月壬寅，以尚書禮部員外郎移剌履為高麗生日使。 十二月戊寅，高麗戶部尚書梁翼京、府少監卿崔素謝勑祭，司宰少卿康勇儒謝慰問，禮賔少卿崔仁謝起復。
cells.literal: On the day renyin of the eleventh month, Supervising Secretary of the Ministry of Rites Yelü Lü was appointed Goryeo birthday envoy. On the day wuyin of the twelfth month, Goryeo Minister of Revenue Liang Yijing and Palace Attendant Minor Official Cui Su thanked them for the imperial condolence mission, Director of Sacrifices Minor Official Kang Yongru thanked them for the consolation mission, and Minor Official of Guests Cui Ren thanked them for the mission urging resumption of office.
cells.idiomatic: On renyin day in the eleventh month Supervising Secretary of the Ministry of Rites Yelü Lü was appointed birthday envoy to Goryeo. cells.content: 二十六年
cells.literal: Twenty-sixth year
cells.idiomatic: Twenty-sixth year

cells.content: 正月庚辰朔，宋使賀正旦。 三月己卯朔，宋試戶部尚書章森、容州觀察使吳曦等賀萬春節。 八月，以益都尹宗浩、左諫議大夫黃久約為賀宋生日使。 十一月，以刑部尚書移剌子元、尚書左司郎中馬琪為賀宋正旦使。
cells.literal: On the first day of the first month, the day gengchen, Song envoys congratulated the New Year. On the first day of the third month, the day jimao, Acting Minister of Revenue of Song Zhang Sen, Rongzhou Observation Commissioner Wu Xi, and others congratulated the Wan Spring Festival. In the eighth month, Metropolitan Governor of Yidu Zonghao and Left Remonstrator Huang Jiuyue were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday. In the eleventh month, Minister of Punishments Yelü Ziyuan and Supervising Secretary of the Left Bureau Ma Qi were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.

In the eleventh month Minister of Punishments Yelü Ziyuan and Supervising Secretary of the Left Bureau Ma Qi were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.

cells.content: 正月庚辰朔，夏武功大夫麻骨進德、宣德郎劉光國等賀正旦。 三月己卯朔，夏武功大夫麻骨德懋、宣德郎王慶崇等賀萬春節。 八月己丑，以宿直將軍李達可為夏生日使。

cells.content: 正月庚辰朔，尚書工部侍郎崔仁請賀正旦，以宣孝太子未大燒飯，詔權停三日曲宴禮，三國人使各賜在館宴。 二月丁丑，高麗戶部侍郎門義赫進奉。 三月己卯朔，高麗禮部侍郎柳公權賀萬春節。 四月壬戌，以客省使李磐為橫賜高麗使。 十二月庚子，高麗禮部侍郎任濡謝橫賜，禮賔少卿盧元謝生日。
cells.literal: On the first day of the first month, the day gengchen, Vice Minister of Works Cui Ren requested to congratulate the New Year; because the Xuanxiao Crown Prince’s great funeral meal had not yet been held, an edict temporarily suspended the three-day curved banquet rite and ordered that envoys from the three states each be granted a banquet in the lodging. On the day dingchou of the second month, Goryeo Vice Minister of Revenue Men Yihe came as tribute envoy. On the first day of the third month, the day jimao, Goryeo Vice Minister of Rites Liu Gongquan congratulated the Wan Spring Festival. On the day renxu of the fourth month, Guest Reception Commissioner Li Pan was appointed sideways-grant envoy to Goryeo. On the day gengzi of the twelfth month, Goryeo Vice Minister of Rites Ren Ru thanked them for the sideways grant, and Minor Official of Guests Lu Yuan thanked them for the birthday gift.

On gengzi day in the twelfth month Vice Minister of Rites Ren Ru thanked the court for the sideways grant and Minor Official of Guests Lu Yuan for the birthday gift.

cells.content: 二十七年
cells.literal: Twenty-seventh year
cells.idiomatic: Twenty-seventh year

cells.content: 正月癸卯朔，宋遣試刑部尚書李巘、漳州觀察使趙多才賀正旦。 三月癸卯朔，宋遣試兵部尚書張淑春、鄂州觀察使謝卓然等賀萬春節。 九月，以河中尹田彥臯、近侍局使宗室鶻殺虎為賀宋生日使。 十月乙亥，宋前主殂。 十一月，以殿前左副都點檢崇安、翰林侍講學士兼御史中丞李晏為賀宋正旦使。 十二月壬午，宋敷文閣學士韋璞、鄂州觀察使姜特立來告哀。
cells.literal: On the first day of the first month, the day guimao, Song sent Acting Minister of Punishments Li Yan and Zhangzhou Observation Commissioner Zhao Duocai to congratulate the New Year. On the first day of the third month, the day guimao, Song sent Acting Minister of War Zhang Shuchun, Ezhou Observation Commissioner Xie Zhuoran, and others to congratulate the Wan Spring Festival. In the ninth month, Metropolitan Governor of Hezhong Tian Yan’gao and Attendant of the Inner Service Bureau Husahu of the Imperial Clan were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday. On the day yihai of the tenth month, the former Song emperor died. In the eleventh month, Left Deputy Commander of the Palace Front Chong’an and Hanlin Academician-in-Attendance and Vice Censor-in-Chief Li Yan were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year. On the day renwu of the twelfth month, Song Academician of the Fuwen Hall Wei Pu and Ezhou Observation Commissioner Jiang Telai came to announce the mourning.

On renwu day in the twelfth month Academician of the Fuwen Hall Wei Pu and Ezhou Observation Commissioner Jiang Telai came to announce the mourning.

cells.content: 正月癸卯朔，夏武功大夫18px|㝹德昭、宣德郎索遵德賀正旦。 三月癸卯朔，夏武功大夫遇忠輔、宣德郎呂昌齡等賀萬春節。 九月己酉，以武器署令斜卯阿土為夏生日使。 十二月，夏殿前太尉訛羅紹先、樞密直學士嚴立本謝橫賜。

On the first day of the third month, the day guimao, Goryeo Vice Minister of Revenue Li Gongjun congratulated the Wan Spring Festival. On the day jiawu, Goryeo Minor Official of Guests Cui Cun thanked them for the birthday gift.

cells.content: 二十八年
cells.literal: Twenty-eighth year
cells.idiomatic: Twenty-eighth year

cells.content: 正月丁酉朔，宋試工部尚書萬鍾、宜州觀察使趙不違賀正旦。是月，以左宣徽使駙馬都尉蒲察克忠、戶部尚書劉瑋為宋弔祭使。 二月，宋試戶部尚書顏師魯、福州觀察使高震來進其前主遺留禮物。 三月丁酉朔，宋試戶部尚書胡晉臣、鄂州觀察使鄭康孫賀萬春節。 五月甲辰，宋試禮部尚書京鏜、容州觀察使劉端仁來報謝。 九月丙申，以安武軍節度使王克溫、近侍局使鶻殺虎為賀宋生日使。 十一月，以河中尹田彥臯、吏部侍郎移剌仲方為賀宋正旦使。
cells.literal: On the first day of the first month, the day dingyou, Acting Minister of Works of Song Wan Zhong and Yizhou Observation Commissioner Zhao Buwei congratulated the New Year. That same month, Left Commissioner of the Palace Directorate and Commissioner-in-Chief of the Empress’s Household Pucha Kezhong and Minister of Revenue Liu Wei were appointed Song condolence envoys. In the second month, Acting Minister of Revenue of Song Yan Shilu and Fuzhou Observation Commissioner Gao Zhen came to present the former emperor’s remaining gifts. On the first day of the third month, the day dingyou, Acting Minister of Revenue Hu Jinchen and Ezhou Observation Commissioner Zheng Kangsun congratulated the Wan Spring Festival. On the day jiachen of the fifth month, Acting Minister of Rites of Song Jing Tang, Rongzhou Observation Commissioner Liu Duanren, and others came to express thanks. On the day bingshen of the ninth month, Military Commissioner of Anwu Wang Kewen and Attendant of the Inner Service Bureau Husahu were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday. In the eleventh month, Metropolitan Governor of Hezhong Tian Yan’gao and Vice Minister of Personnel Yelü Zhongfang were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.

cells.content: 二十九年
cells.literal: Twenty-ninth year
cells.idiomatic: Twenty-ninth year

cells.content: 正月壬辰朔，宋顯謨閣學士鄭僑、廣州觀察使張時修等賀正旦。上大漸，宋正旦使遣還。 甲辰，遣大理卿王元德等報哀於宋。 二月，宋主內禪，子惇嗣立。 四月辛未，宋葛廷瑞、趙不慢來弔祭。 五月壬寅，宋遣羅點、譙熈載來報嗣位。 戊午，遣東北路招討使溫迪罕速可等使宋賀即位。閏月庚辰，宋遣沈揆、韓侂冑來賀登位。 六月乙卯，勑有司移報宋天壽節。 七月辛巳，遣刑部尚書完顏守貞等為賀宋生辰使。 八月丙辰，宋遣禮部尚書謝深甫、觀察使趙昂賀天壽節。 十一月辛酉，遣右宣徽使裴滿餘慶等為賀宋正旦使。
cells.literal: On the first day of the first month, the day renchen, Song Academician of the Xianmo Pavilion Zheng Qiao, Guangzhou Observation Commissioner Zhang Shixiu, and others congratulated the New Year. The emperor fell gravely ill, and the Song New Year envoys were sent back. On the day jiachen, Chief Justice Wang Yuande and others were dispatched to announce the mourning to Song. In the second month, the Song ruler abdicated in favor of his son, and Zun succeeded to the throne. On the day xinwei of the fourth month, Song Ge Tingrui and Zhao Buman came to offer condolence sacrifices. On the day renyin of the fifth month, Song sent Luo Dian and Qiao Xizai to report the succession. On the day wuwu, Northeast Route Pacification Commissioner Wendihan Suke and others were sent to Song to congratulate the accession. On the day gengchen of the intercalary month, Song sent Shen Kui and Han Tuozhou to congratulate the enthronement. On the day yimao of the sixth month, an edict ordered the relevant offices to notify Song of the Heavenly Longevity Festival. On the day xinsi of the seventh month, Minister of Punishments Wanyan Shouzhen and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday. On the day bingchen of the eighth month, Song sent Minister of Rites Xie Shenfu and Observation Commissioner Zhao Ang to congratulate the Heavenly Longevity Festival. On the day xinyou of the eleventh month, Right Commissioner of the Palace Directorate Peiman Yuqing and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on the New Year.

cells.content: 正月壬辰朔，高麗禮賔少卿李尚儒賀正旦。上大漸，高麗使遣還。 六月乙卯，高麗檢校尚書右僕射戶部尚書李英搢、檢校工部尚書戶部侍郎黃清來奏會葬、並祭奠。 七月辛未，高麗檢校太尉鄭存實、殿中監任沖來賀登位。 八月，高麗遣戶部尚書崔膺庸賀天壽節。 十二月，高麗禮部侍郎閔湜謝生日，戶部侍郎孫衍謝橫賜。
cells.literal: On the first day of the first month, the day renchen, Goryeo Minor Official of Guests Li Shangru congratulated the New Year. The emperor fell gravely ill, and the Goryeo envoys were sent back. On the day yimao of the sixth month, Goryeo Acting Vice Director of the Right Secretariat and Minister of Revenue Li Yingjin and Acting Minister of Works and Vice Minister of Revenue Huang Qing came to memorialize joint burial and to offer condolence sacrifices. On the day xinwei of the seventh month, Goryeo Acting Grand Commandant Zheng Cunshi and Palace Attendant Director Ren Chong came to congratulate the enthronement. In the eighth month, Goryeo sent Minister of Revenue Cui Yingyong to congratulate the Heavenly Longevity Festival. In the twelfth month, Goryeo Vice Minister of Rites Min Shi thanked them for the birthday gift, and Vice Minister of Revenue Sun Yan thanked them for the sideways grant.
